Which AI prompt gets the better result? A 4-round quiz for small business owners

I ran every prompt in this quiz myself, both versions, and compared what came back.

Round 1: a review reply. Round 2: a weekend sale post. Round 3: an appointment reminder. Round 4: an About page. Guess first, then swipe for the answer.

The pattern behind every winner:
1) Give the details: what happened, what's on offer, what you need.
2) Set a length: "under 50 words" or "2 lines".
3) Skip the fancy job title. "World-class copywriter" added polish, not facts.
4) When AI can't know your story, let it ask first:

"Ask me 5 questions about my business, one at a time. Then write my About page from my answers."

Tell me your score in the comments: 4/4?
